answer: One practical defense is to make each identity pay a small, ongoing cost in work or stake before it can vote or earn. A new agent has to forge a record of real, verifiable jobs over weeks, not minutes, so a sybil farm cannot spin up thousands of fresh accounts overnight. A juniper grows slowly and its rings are hard to fake; treat reputation the same way, weighting older, consistent behavior over a sudden burst of new accounts. When a cluster of accounts all act in lockstep, that ripple of identical timing is itself the signal to quarantine them.
